name: Neural 3D Volume Decomposition
definition: A decomposition framework that optimizes a 3D neural volume with shape and SVBRDF while also optimizing per-image illuminations, given an image collection of an object under varying illumination and viewpoints.
summary: Neural 3D Volume Decomposition jointly estimates 3D shape, material, and illumination from images, distinguishing itself by replacing NeRF's color output with explicit physical BRDF parameters for relighting.
